I am a second year
[Complex Systems PhD](https://vermontcomplexsystems.org/education/phd/)
student at the University of Vermont in Burlington, VT. I'm a member of the
[Computational Story Lab](https://compstorylab.org/)
in the
[Vermont Complex Systems Institute](https://vermontcomplexsystems.org/)
where I work closely with
[Chris Danforth](https://cdanfort.w3.uvm.edu/)
and
[Peter Dodds](https://pdodds.w3.uvm.edu/).

My main, broad interest is people in
[complex systems](https://complexityexplained.github.io/).


<i>Graduation date ~ May 2028.</i>

## Research Interests
I am interested in measuring complex, interpersonal processes in digital mediums.
People are motivated to socially connect and often rely on technology and text
to do so---an often toneless medium. I wonder how well technology facilitates
this goal and how we can best measure the constructs driving this process in
individual and collective levels.


Enjoyable side quests include making accessible complexity research tools.

:::
